lines.text: Timothy is asked to come quickly because Demas, loving this world, has deserted the writer and gone to Thessalonica.
Only Luke is with Paul, who tells Timothy to bring Mark and says he sent Tychicus to Smyrna.
Timothy is asked to bring the cloak left with Carpus at Troas, and the scrolls, especially the parchments.
Alexander the silversmith did Paul great harm, and Timothy should beware of him because he opposed their message.
At the first defense everyone deserted the writer, but the Lord stood by him so all the Gentiles would hear.
